```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
```

Load in phyloseq objects
```{r}
fun_rna = readRDS("../../TidyData/Phyloseq/Tidy_relativize_phyloseq_objects/Results/psITS_relative_RNA_mip.rds")
bac_rna = readRDS("../../TidyData/Phyloseq/Tidy_relativize_phyloseq_objects/Results/ps16S_relative_RNA_mip.rds")
```

collapse fungi to genus
```{r}
# first see what it looked like before
fun_tt = data.frame(tax_table(fun_rna))
colnames(fun_tt)

# do it in the tax table
ps_fun_gen = tax_glom(fun_rna, taxrank = "Genus")
fun_gen_tt = data.frame(tax_table(ps_fun_gen))
colnames(fun_gen_tt)

```

```{r}
# 1. Agglomerate by Genus
ps_fun_gen <- tax_glom(fun_rna, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

# 2. Extract the Tax Table as a data frame to make it easier to manipulate
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_fun_gen))

# 3. Create a 'Unique Name' column 
# This handles NAs by using the ASV ID, and ensures Genus names are unique
tax_df$Unique_Node_Name <- ifelse(
  is.na(tax_df$Genus) | tax_df$Genus == "", 
  paste0("Unclass_", rownames(tax_df)), # Use ASV ID for unclassified
  as.character(tax_df$Genus)
)

# 4. CRITICAL: Check for any duplicate Genus names that survived glomming
# If two different families have a genus with the same name, this fixes it
if(any(duplicated(tax_df$Unique_Node_Name))){
  tax_df$Unique_Node_Name <- make.unique(tax_df$Unique_Node_Name)
}

# 5. Assign these unique strings back as the taxa names
taxa_names(ps_fun_gen) <- tax_df$Unique_Node_Name

# 6. Update the tax_table inside the object so metadata matches names
tax_table(ps_fun_gen) <- as.matrix(tax_df)
```

make sample names describe soil cores, not barcode pairs
```{r}
eam = read_csv("../../TidyData/Metadata/Results/extraction_and_amplification_metadata_mip.csv") #read in extraction and amplification metadata, which links barcode pairs to soil core samples

all_barcodes = eam %>%
  select(c(FWD_barcode, REV_barcode, nucleic_acid, amplification, DO_ID)) # trim eam down to relevant info

all_barcodes_DO_R1 = all_barcodes %>% 
  mutate(barcodes = str_c("DO_", REV_barcode, "_", FWD_barcode, "_R1.fastq.gz"))
head(all_barcodes_DO_R1)

better_barcode_key =  all_barcodes_DO_R1 %>% 
  select(barcodes, DO_ID)

otu_ids <- rna_otu %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "barcodes") %>%
  left_join(better_barcode_key, by = "barcodes") %>%
  relocate(DO_ID, .after = barcodes) # moves the ID column to the front instead of being after all the asv-specific columns

head(colnames(otu_ids))
otu_ids$DO_ID # yayyyy it worked!
```
